title: Thank you for this app!
body: This app makes reminders beautiful! It’s also very practical and well thought out. The watch app works well and does what I need. So I am thankful to the team for this app.
author: user me 009

title: Great but could use an overview of all habit check-ins
body:
I really enjoy the app. Its fairly easy to check-in, it looks great and offers variability in the habit setting (for example weekly habits or multiple check-ins in a day).
That said, i would love to see a feature that shows all of my habits at once - like a monthly view or a list with all my check-ins.
I would also like if it showed a green checkmark for the daily habits when completed (now it’s only after finishing the weekly plan for the daily habits - that doesn’t really make sense to me). Thank you for this app and keep up the good work!
author: Rachuzee

title: Simplicity is power
body: I like it because it's simple and intuitive. The analyses are great so you can have a feedback over your progress in the glimpse of the eye! The sign of motivation is imbedded as well and that's all packed in modern and eye catching design!
author: Maroslavius
